sections.name: Stallone Shaikh

photo.alt: Stallone Shaikh, Founder and CEO of Alliance Street Group

paragraphs: Stallone Shaikh founded Alliance Street Consultancy in 2022 after a career in finance that included JPMorgan Chase and Mashreq Bank. His experience working with entrepreneurs in the UAE shaped a practical approach: understand how a business will operate before recommending its structure.

Raised between Mumbai and Goa, Stallone began working at seventeen and later moved to Dubai. He progressed from sales into relationship management, gaining first-hand insight into the banking and operational challenges business owners face.

Today, he leads Alliance Street Group with a focus on connecting company formation, banking, accounting and advisory support. He is also the author of Dubai Dreams & Tax-Free Schemes, sharing lessons from his journey with entrepreneurs exploring the UAE.

sections.lead: Alliance Street started in Business Bay because two markets full of founders were getting the same bad deal.
paragraphs: UAE free zones move fast, but the advice around them often doesn't: generic packages, upsold add-ons, and a setup agent who disappears the moment your licence prints. UK incorporation has the opposite problem — accurate, but disconnected from what's actually happening on the ground in Dubai for founders running both.

We built Alliance Street to close that gap: one advisory relationship that understands UAE structuring and UK compliance well enough to plan across both, and stays on after the paperwork is filed to handle the tax, accounting, and questions that come after.
